paid_output.editorial_angle: Сильнее всего работает контраст между максимальным intelligence index и стоимостью выполненной задачи: автор на Хабре сознательно выбрал второй критерий. Основа — E1 и E2.
paid_output.objective: Reach: показать неожиданный, применимый подход квы

slides.slide_copy: Максимальный intelligence index проиграл стоимости задачи
slides.slide_body: Автор на Хабре перешёл от самых умных и дорогих моделей к более дешёвым.
slides.visual_direction: Use the available dark source image as a full-frame editorial field, with the subject cropped away from the top-right calm zone. The headline sits in that quiet area while the darker image carries the tension between model intelligence and task cost.
slides.slide_purpose: Создать удивление через резкое сравнение двух критериев и сразу показать, что автор заменил дорогие модели более дешёвыми.
slides.media_need: Available source image, shown full-bleed with a different crop from later slides.
slides.visual_family_reason: The available dark source image can carry a high-impact opening while the calm zone supports the sharp comparison.

slides.slide_body: Вместо самых умных и дорогих моделей автор выбрал более дешёвые — под конкретную стоимость выполненной задачи.
slides.visual_direction: Show a portrait generated scene of a developer at a desk choosing between two blank, unbranded model cards: one physically oversized and one smaller, with the hand moving toward the smaller card. The visual is a concrete metaphor for choosing a cheaper model by task cost, not a depiction of a named product.
slides.slide_purpose: Объяснить, что именно изменилось в подходе автора, не повторяя формулировку hook.
slides.media_need: Generated contextual scene showing the choice between an oversized and a smaller blank model card.
slides.visual_family_reason: A calm split composition makes the change in selection criteria easy to understand beside a concrete generated choice scene.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial scene in a dark workspace: a developer’s hand chooses between two blank, unbranded rectangular model cards, one oversized and one smaller, on a desk. The smaller card is closer to the hand; no text, logos, interface, numbers or readable markings appear.
slides.story_anchor: The author moved from the most intelligent and expensive models to cheaper ones.

slides.slide_body: Автор ориентируется на стоимость выполненной задачи, а не на максимальный intelligence index.
slides.visual_direction: Build a substantive dark flow diagram as the visual: three connected nodes show the order from task to cost to model. Keep the diagram editorial and sparse, with the available source image reduced to a narrow cropped fragment at the edge as contextual evidence.
slides.slide_purpose: Зафиксировать точный критерий автора и превратить новость в понятную схему выбора.
slides.media_need: Substantive flow diagram with a small supporting crop of the available source image.
slides.visual_family_reason: A flow diagram directly communicates the evidence-based order of criteria instead of turning the slide into a text card.

slides.slide_copy: Сначала стоимость результата. Потом — интеллект модели.
slides.slide_body: Подход автора оставляет максимальный intelligence index не ответом по умолчанию, а одним из критериев выбора.
slides.visual_direction: Show a generated close editorial still life that returns to the shared decision motif: a smaller blank model card sits in the foreground beside a larger card pushed slightly back. The physical depth makes the takeaway visible without adding unsupported product details or text.
slides.slide_purpose: Закрыть историю практичным выводом: максимальный интеллект модели не должен автоматически становиться главным критерием.
slides.media_need: Generated conceptual still life using the same blank model-card motif from the context slide.
slides.visual_family_reason: A dark concluding statement paired with the recurring two-card visual turns the evidence into a memorable decision rule.
slides.generation_brief: Portrait editorial still life on a dark desk: a smaller blank unbranded model card is in sharp foreground focus while a larger blank card sits farther back and slightly out of focus. No text, numbers, logos, interface elements or product branding appear.
slides.story_anchor: The cost of the completed task became more important than the maximum intelligence index.

paid_output.final_caption: История с Хабра — не про отказ от умных моделей. Она про смену вопроса: не «какая модель сильнее?», а «какая стоимость у выполненной задачи?». Если выбираешь модель под работу, этот порядок критериев стоит хотя бы проверить на своих задачах.

creative_execution_plan.main_idea: A recurring editorial world of model selection: dark workspaces, blank unbranded model cards and a visible contrast between the oversized expensive-looking option and the smaller task-focused option.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: The physical choice between a larger and a smaller blank model card, representing the shift from maximum intelligence index to task cost.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: The available source image is strong for the opening and evidence, but generated contextual scenes are needed to make the abstract selection criterion visually understandable and memorable.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Alternate a full-bleed source opening, an explanatory split scene, a substantive flow diagram and a calm dark conclusion. Use asymmetrical crops and keep the cards visually dominant when they appear.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Use a restrained NINJA red accent, dark editorial surfaces and clear corner logo placement without product references.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Dark editorial decision-desk motif with unbranded blank cards, sharp scale contrast and controlled red marks; no text or logos inside generated media.
creative_execution_plan.avoid_recent_treatment: No recent Instagram treatment is available, so avoid generic news-card repetition and keep the visual progression story-led.

visual_rhythm.arc: The carousel moves from a sharp criterion clash to the author’s change in approach, then maps the decision order and ends with a memorable practical rule.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: The blank model-card motif repeats intentionally on slides 2 and 4, with different scale, crop and narrative function.
